name: smwgraphics-jikkyou-oshaberi-parodius-snes-menu
title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (SNES) - Menu
description:
A very simple background from Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius, that's used in its menu. Best used for switch palaces, bonus levels or abstract levels. It's a very light background, which means that the user has a lot of graphic space left to use.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
